<think>

<action type="say">
Here’s how to cancel it in OpenTable.

On the OpenTable mobile app:
1) Open the OpenTable app and sign in (same account you used to book).
2) Tap the “Profile,” “Me,” or person icon (usually bottom-right).
3) Tap “Reservations” or “Upcoming.”
4) Find the reservation that matches:
   - This Thursday, 7:00 PM  
   - Party of 4  
   - The Italian restaurant in downtown Fort Worth
5) Tap that reservation to open its details.
6) Tap “Cancel Reservation.”
7) If it asks for a reason, pick something like “Change of plans” and you can add “Traveling for work.”
8) Confirm when it asks if you’re sure.

You should then see a canceled status on that reservation and get an email or notification confirming the cancellation.

On the OpenTable website (if you prefer):
1) Go to opentable.com and sign in.
2) Click your name/profile in the top-right → choose “My Dining History” or “Reservations.”
3) Under “Upcoming,” find Thursday’s 7 PM reservation.
4) Click the reservation → click “Cancel Reservation” → confirm.

If you don’t see that reservation under “Upcoming,” tell me exactly what you do see (only past reservations, nothing at all, or a different date), and I’ll help you troubleshoot the next step.</action>
